product.desc:
Foldable Feature



The foldable design makes storage easy and convenient, saving space in your home or garage.






Multiple Sizes Available



Available in 14, 16, and 18-inch sizes, this bike ensures a perfect fit for children of different heights and stages of growth.






Single-Sex Operation



Designed for single-sex operation, this bike provides a comfortable and safe riding experience for young children.






Gender-Inclusive Design



With its unisex design, the bike is suitable for both boys and girls, promoting inclusivity and equality in playtime.






Versatile Age Range



Designed for children aged 2-8, this foldable bike caters to a wide age group, making it a versatile choice for growing kids.

title: Folding Children's Bike
detail_text: Unisex With its neutral design, this bicycle suits both boys and girls, promoting inclusivity. Foldable Design The foldable feature makes it easy to store and transport, ideal for families on the go. Pedal Power Equipped with pedals, this bicycle encourages physical activity and skill development. Versatile Age Range Designed for children aged 2-9 years, this bicycle is perfect for growing kids. Durability Built to withstand the rough and tumble of childhood play, ensuring long-lasting use.
detail_html:
Unisex



With its neutral design, this bicycle suits both boys and girls, promoting inclusivity.






Foldable Design



The foldable feature makes it easy to store and transport, ideal for families on the go.






Pedal Power



Equipped with pedals, this bicycle encourages physical activity and skill development.






Versatile Age Range



Designed for children aged 2-9 years, this bicycle is perfect for growing kids.






Durability



Built to withstand the rough and tumble of childhood play, ensuring long-lasting use.

Durability



Built to withstand the rough and tumble of childhood play, ensuring long-lasting use.

detail_text: Add-On Feature One of its unique features is the ability to add a back seat, turning it into a tandem bike. This makes it an ideal choice for parents who want to ride with their children. Easy Folding The bicycle's easy-to-fold design allows for quick setup and storage. It's perfect for those who need a bike that can be easily transported from one place to another. Children's Safety Designed with children's safety in mind, this bicycle comes with a sturdy frame and reliable brakes. It's a safe and fun way for kids to learn how to ride a bike. Versatile Use This bicycle is not just for adults but also suitable for children. It can be used for leisurely rides, sports, and entertainment, making it a versatile choice. Entertainment Value With its fun and vibrant design, this bicycle adds an element of entertainment to your child's playtime. It's a great way to keep them active and engaged.

product.desc:
Add-On Feature



One of its unique features is the ability to add a back seat, turning it into a tandem bike. This makes it an ideal choice for parents who want to ride with their children.






Easy Folding



The bicycle's easy-to-fold design allows for quick setup and storage. It's perfect for those who need a bike that can be easily transported from one place to another.






Children's Safety



Designed with children's safety in mind, this bicycle comes with a sturdy frame and reliable brakes. It's a safe and fun way for kids to learn how to ride a bike.






Versatile Use



This bicycle is not just for adults but also suitable for children. It can be used for leisurely rides, sports, and entertainment, making it a versatile choice.






Entertainment Value



With its fun and vibrant design, this bicycle adds an element of entertainment to your child's playtime. It's a great way to keep them active and engaged.

page_json.description: <html> <head></head> <body>  Add-On Feature   One of its unique features is the ability to add a back seat, turning it into a tandem bike. This makes it an ideal choice for parents who want to ride with their children.    Easy Folding   The bicycle's easy-to-fold design allows for quick setup and storage. It's perfect for those who need a bike that can be easily transported from one place to another.    Children's Safety   Designed with children's safety in mind, this bicycle comes with a sturdy frame and reliable brakes. It's a safe and fun way for kids to learn how to ride a bike.    Versatile Use   This bicycle is not just for adults but also suitable for children. It can be used for leisurely rides, sports, and entertainment, making it a versatile choice.    Entertainment Value   With its fun and vibrant design, this bicycle adds an element of entertainment to your child's playtime. It's a great way to keep them active and engaged.     </body></html>

title: Portable Folding Bicycle with Shock Absorption 20 Inch
detail_text: Shock Absorption Feature Equipped with a shock absorption feature, this bicycle provides a smooth and comfortable ride, reducing the impact of rough terrain. 20-inch Wheel Size With its 20-inch wheel size, this bicycle offers a balance between maneuverability and speed, suitable for various riding conditions. Unisex Adult Bicycle This bicycle is suitable for both men and women, making it a versatile choice for adult users. It's ideal for students and professionals alike. Ultra-light Foldable Design The new foldable bicycle is designed for easy portability, making it perfect for commuting or travel. Its ultra-lightweight construction ensures effortless handling. Versatile Use Whether for transportation to work or school, or for leisurely rides, this bicycle is a practical choice. Its design makes it suitable for a wide range of users.
detail_html:
Shock Absorption Feature

Equipped with a shock absorption feature, this bicycle provides a smooth and comfortable ride, reducing the impact of rough terrain.

20-inch Wheel Size

With its 20-inch wheel size, this bicycle offers a balance between maneuverability and speed, suitable for various riding conditions.

Unisex Adult Bicycle

This bicycle is suitable for both men and women, making it a versatile choice for adult users. It's ideal for students and professionals alike.

Ultra-light Foldable Design

The new foldable bicycle is designed for easy portability, making it perfect for commuting or travel. Its ultra-lightweight construction ensures effortless handling.

Versatile Use

Whether for transportation to work or school, or for leisurely rides, this bicycle is a practical choice. Its design makes it suitable for a wide range of users.

product.desc:
Shock Absorption Feature

Equipped with a shock absorption feature, this bicycle provides a smooth and comfortable ride, reducing the impact of rough terrain.

20-inch Wheel Size

With its 20-inch wheel size, this bicycle offers a balance between maneuverability and speed, suitable for various riding conditions.

Unisex Adult Bicycle

This bicycle is suitable for both men and women, making it a versatile choice for adult users. It's ideal for students and professionals alike.

Ultra-light Foldable Design

The new foldable bicycle is designed for easy portability, making it perfect for commuting or travel. Its ultra-lightweight construction ensures effortless handling.

Versatile Use

Whether for transportation to work or school, or for leisurely rides, this bicycle is a practical choice. Its design makes it suitable for a wide range of users.

page_json.category: Sports & Outdoors Activities Equipment > Outdoor Sports & Activities Equipment > Cycling > Bikes
page_json.description: Shock Absorption FeatureEquipped with a shock absorption feature, this bicycle provides a smooth and comfortable ride, reducing the impact of rough terrain.20-inch Wheel SizeWith its 20-inch wheel size, this bicycle offers a balance between maneuverability and speed, suitable for various riding conditions.Unisex Adult BicycleThis bicycle is suitable for both men and women, making it a versatile choice for adult users. It's ideal for students and professionals alike.Ultra-light Foldable DesignThe new foldable bicycle is designed for easy portability, making it perfect for commuting or travel. Its ultra-lightweight construction ensures effortless handling.Versatile UseWhether for transportation to work or school, or for leisurely rides, this bicycle is a practical choice. Its design makes it suitable for a wide range of users.

title: Portable Folding Bike 20 Inch
detail_text: Versatile Size With a 20-inch wheel size, this bicycle is suitable for both men and women, as well as middle school students, offering a versatile option for various users. Compact and Portable Its compact size makes it easy to carry around, whether you're traveling or just need to navigate through crowded city streets. Durable Material Constructed with durable materials, this bicycle ensures longevity and can withstand regular use, making it a reliable choice for cycling enthusiasts. Adult Suitable Designed specifically for adults, this bicycle provides a comfortable ride and is ideal for daily commuting or recreational cycling. Foldable Design The foldable design of this bicycle allows for easy storage and transportation, making it perfect for adults who need to store it in their car trunks.
detail_html:
Versatile Size



With a 20-inch wheel size, this bicycle is suitable for both men and women, as well as middle school students, offering a versatile option for various users.






Compact and Portable



Its compact size makes it easy to carry around, whether you're traveling or just need to navigate through crowded city streets.






Durable Material



Constructed with durable materials, this bicycle ensures longevity and can withstand regular use, making it a reliable choice for cycling enthusiasts.






Adult Suitable



Designed specifically for adults, this bicycle provides a comfortable ride and is ideal for daily commuting or recreational cycling.






Foldable Design



The foldable design of this bicycle allows for easy storage and transportation, making it perfect for adults who need to store it in their car trunks.

product.desc:
Versatile Size



With a 20-inch wheel size, this bicycle is suitable for both men and women, as well as middle school students, offering a versatile option for various users.






Compact and Portable



Its compact size makes it easy to carry around, whether you're traveling or just need to navigate through crowded city streets.






Durable Material



Constructed with durable materials, this bicycle ensures longevity and can withstand regular use, making it a reliable choice for cycling enthusiasts.






Adult Suitable



Designed specifically for adults, this bicycle provides a comfortable ride and is ideal for daily commuting or recreational cycling.






Foldable Design



The foldable design of this bicycle allows for easy storage and transportation, making it perfect for adults who need to store it in their car trunks.

detail_html:
Description

CACCO A16R – A16R – Lightweight, Rigid, and Built to Impress.

  • Seamless Design – T6061 aluminum frame with smooth, weld-free joints for elegance and unmatched rigidity.
  • Upgrade-Friendly – 130mm rear spacing fits Shimano, SRAM, and more, giving you unlimited drivetrain upgrade options.
  • Effortless Riding – 53T chainring + 11–28T cassette + 9-speed Shimano for smooth pedaling in both city cruising and long-distance rides.
  • Ride in Comfort – Ergonomic saddle, seatpost, handlebar, pedals, and grips designed for all-day comfort.
  • Make It Yours – 9 frame colors, multiple wheel setups, and color-matched accessories for your perfect style.

Specification:

  • Frameset :

    * Frame | Fork | Stem| Rear Triangle: Cacco ,  Aluminium Alloy ,Rim brake & Trifold design.
  • Frame accessories：

    * Rear Rack: Aluminium alloy design.

    * Easy-wheel : Al alloy, OD-Ø65mm  * 4.

    * Suspension Block: Cacco Rubber Design.

    * Headset: Cacco Al alloy 34-34 seal bearing threaded.
  • Wheelset :

    * Wheel: Cacco 16inches (Ø349mm) alloy wheelset / Cacco Carbon Fiber Aero Trispoke wheelset – Optional.

    * Tyre: Schwable One,  349c*35c , 175g *2

    * Inner tube: CST Lite *2 ,349c*28c,   65g *2
  • Transmission:

    * Shifter & Derailleurs: SHIMANO extenal 9 speed.

    * Crankset : Cacco ELite hollow-tech,130BCD,53T, 720g

    * Chain:  Cacco,  1/2″ x 11/128″ , 114 links, 330g

    * Bottom bracket: Cacco, BB24 * 68mm, 100g

    * Cassette: 9 Speed , 11T-28T,  235g
  • Cockpit set:

    * Saddle: Cacco Carbon Fiber PU comfort, 190g

    * Seatpost:  Cacco Carbon Fiber, Ø31.8 mm * L350mm , 220g

    * Handlebar:  Cacco Carbon Fiber Straight bar / Y bar (Ø25.2mm*L520) , 60g-– Optional.

    * Handle grip:  Cacco Comfort Rubber (Ø22.2mm*L100mm), 60g .

    * Padel:  Cacco foldable alloy platform, 250g
  • Brakeset:

    * Brake set: Cacco alloy rim caliper, Front & Rear
  • Complete bike weight:

    Complete bike : 8.7 KG.

brand.suggestion: More Outdoor Sports & Activities Equipment from Cacco

product.desc:
Description

CACCO A16R – A16R – Lightweight, Rigid, and Built to Impress.

  • Seamless Design – T6061 aluminum frame with smooth, weld-free joints for elegance and unmatched rigidity.
  • Upgrade-Friendly – 130mm rear spacing fits Shimano, SRAM, and more, giving you unlimited drivetrain upgrade options.
  • Effortless Riding – 53T chainring + 11–28T cassette + 9-speed Shimano for smooth pedaling in both city cruising and long-distance rides.
  • Ride in Comfort – Ergonomic saddle, seatpost, handlebar, pedals, and grips designed for all-day comfort.
  • Make It Yours – 9 frame colors, multiple wheel setups, and color-matched accessories for your perfect style.

Specification:

  • Frameset :

    * Frame | Fork | Stem| Rear Triangle: Cacco ,  Aluminium Alloy ,Rim brake & Trifold design.
  • Frame accessories：

    * Rear Rack: Aluminium alloy design.

    * Easy-wheel : Al alloy, OD-Ø65mm  * 4.

    * Suspension Block: Cacco Rubber Design.

    * Headset: Cacco Al alloy 34-34 seal bearing threaded.
  • Wheelset :

    * Wheel: Cacco 16inches (Ø349mm) alloy wheelset / Cacco Carbon Fiber Aero Trispoke wheelset – Optional.

    * Tyre: Schwable One,  349c*35c , 175g *2

    * Inner tube: CST Lite *2 ,349c*28c,   65g *2
  • Transmission:

    * Shifter & Derailleurs: SHIMANO extenal 9 speed.

    * Crankset : Cacco ELite hollow-tech,130BCD,53T, 720g

    * Chain:  Cacco,  1/2″ x 11/128″ , 114 links, 330g

    * Bottom bracket: Cacco, BB24 * 68mm, 100g

    * Cassette: 9 Speed , 11T-28T,  235g
  • Cockpit set:

    * Saddle: Cacco Carbon Fiber PU comfort, 190g

    * Seatpost:  Cacco Carbon Fiber, Ø31.8 mm * L350mm , 220g

    * Handlebar:  Cacco Carbon Fiber Straight bar / Y bar (Ø25.2mm*L520) , 60g-– Optional.

    * Handle grip:  Cacco Comfort Rubber (Ø22.2mm*L100mm), 60g .

    * Padel:  Cacco foldable alloy platform, 250g
  • Brakeset:

    * Brake set: Cacco alloy rim caliper, Front & Rear
  • Complete bike weight:

    Complete bike : 8.7 KG.

Safety Features   Designed with safety in mind, this bike features durable materials and a sturdy frame to ensure a safe ride for your little one.    Foldable Design   The new foldable children's bicycle is designed for easy storage and transportation, making it perfect for families on the go. detail_text: Adult-Sized Bicycle Designed specifically for adults, this bicycle offers a comfortable and secure ride, catering to the needs of the mature rider. Ultra-lightweight Design The Laing folding bicycle boasts an ultra-lightweight design, making it easy to carry and transport wherever you go. Variable Gears Featuring variable gears, this bicycle allows you to adjust your speed and effort according to the terrain, ensuring a smooth and efficient ride. Versatile 20-inch Wheels Equipped with 20-inch wheels, this bicycle provides a versatile ride, suitable for various terrains and conditions. Compact Foldability Its compact foldability makes it easy to store in small spaces, perfect for urban living or travel.
detail_html:
Adult-Sized Bicycle



Designed specifically for adults, this bicycle offers a comfortable and secure ride, catering to the needs of the mature rider.






Ultra-lightweight Design



The Laing folding bicycle boasts an ultra-lightweight design, making it easy to carry and transport wherever you go.






Variable Gears



Featuring variable gears, this bicycle allows you to adjust your speed and effort according to the terrain, ensuring a smooth and efficient ride.






Versatile 20-inch Wheels



Equipped with 20-inch wheels, this bicycle provides a versatile ride, suitable for various terrains and conditions.






Compact Foldability



Its compact foldability makes it easy to store in small spaces, perfect for urban living or travel.

page_json.description: <html> <head></head> <body>  Adult-Sized Bicycle   Designed specifically for adults, this bicycle offers a comfortable and secure ride, catering to the needs of the mature rider.    Ultra-lightweight Design   The Laing folding bicycle boasts an ultra-lightweight design, making it easy to carry and transport wherever you go.    Variable Gears   Featuring variable gears, this bicycle allows you to adjust your speed and effort according to the terrain, ensuring a smooth and efficient ride.    Versatile 20-inch Wheels   Equipped with 20-inch wheels, this bicycle provides a versatile ride, suitable for various terrains and conditions.    Compact Foldability   Its compact foldability makes it easy to store in small spaces, perfect for urban living or travel.     </body></html>
